title: TCHY_DifficultyAdjustment
description: Several adjustments have been made to the original Minecraft game mechanics, resulting in changes to the game's difficulty.
body:
Because I wasn't satisfied with the difficulty of the original game, I wrote this mod to adjust the game's difficulty.

Currently added features:
- Death reduces maximum health.
- Enchanted golden apples can restore the reduced maximum health, but cannot exceed the original maximum health (unless modified in the configuration file).
- Soulbound enchantment book.
- Death count tracking.
- Added feature: Death coordinates will be displayed in the chat box upon death.
- The Soul Binding effect has been added to the Enchanting Table.
- It enhances the nutritional mechanism of food (eating a variety of foods is necessary for it to be effective).


All of the above features can be selectively enabled in the configuration file.

Further functional debugging and development will follow.
